title: Tencent Hunyuan Launches Open-Source HyMemory 2.0 Framework, Claims Superior Performance Over Opus 5
source_used: KuCoin News flash carrying IT Home's report
key_facts: Tencent Hunyuan announced on 16 Oct 2026 the open-source Agent Memory Framework Hy Memory 2.0, with three layers: a dedicated model, a memory framework and the MemHub application.
Tencent says the framework is the first to propose a memory architecture combining working memory and code memory.
On four benchmarks covering chat, work and code, Tencent says Hy Memory beats open-source frameworks such as Mem0, MemOS, EverOS, OpenViking, RepoMemory and Simple RAG.
On LoCoMo, chat memory reached 72.6% accuracy against EverOS's 71.9% while cutting average tokens per question from 1,159 to 703, a 39.3% decrease.

Hy-Memory-30A3B, trained for memory tasks with about 3B activated parameters, scored 55.49 against Claude Opus 5's 54.62 on a fixed 20% baseline subset of four benchmarks, according to an arXiv paper.
MemHub is a local memory tool (CLI and Mac app) that imports sessions from 10 AI tools, including WorkBuddy, Cursor, Codex, Pi, Qwen Code, Hermes, DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode.
The SDK and MemHub are on GitHub and the Hy-Memory-30B-A3B weights are on Hugging Face.
quote_evidence: IT Home, October 16: Tencent Hunyuan officially announced today the launch of the Agent Memory Framework Hy Memory 2.0, open-sourcing three layers of capabilities: the dedicated model, the memory framework, and the MemHub application.
In tests involving the Hy Memory, Mem0, MemOS, and EverMemOS memory systems, Hy-Memory-30A3B scored 55.49, outperforming Opus 5 at 54.62, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 53.64, and Qwen3-30B-A3B at 44.37.
why_it_matters_hint: A free memory toolkit for AI agents from a major Chinese tech firm, with performance claims that are Tencent's own.
notes: Copy site KuCoin carries IT Home's text; IT Home is the source. Company claims only.
